title: Keel POC implementation — day scratch
content:
(Personal SE scratchpad) Keel PoC for AtlasPay — running notes, to-dos, quick configs. Rough, unpolished.

=== Morning recap (2026-03-10) ===
- Standup takeaway: AtlasPay wants a 99th percentile latency < 180ms for single-turn chat on their validation corpus (avg seq len ~120 tokens).
- Current baseline from hosted: 210ms p99 on rtx-a6000 (unquantized). Need plan: batching / kv-cache / small-variant fallback.

=== Immediate checklist (today) ===
- [ ] Validate model variant mapping: ensure atlaspay-prod -> redwood/llama-3-8b-q4 needs correct kernel flags. (ask runtime team if kernel v2 toggles required)
- [ ] Deploy private PoC cluster in eu-west-1. Minimal: 1x pod (8 A100s) + 1 control-plane node. Confirm VPC peering + route table rules with customer.
- [ ] Run prompt-set of 120 sample queries from customer P0 set. Capture token counts and first-token latency.
- [ ] Smoke test fallback policy: route to redwood/llama-3-8b-fp16 when quantized node full. Verify no auth leakage.
- [ ] Add KV-prefetch test for repeated session prefixes (50 sessions). Measure hit rate.

=== Quick notes / commands to run ===
# k8s-ish: use infra helper script to spin PoC nodes (local helper on my laptop)
./scripts/poc-create --name keel-atlaspay --region eu-west-1 --gpu a100 --count 1 --control small

# SSH into node: (jump via bastion)
ssh -i ~/.ssh/keel_poc.pem ubuntu@34.89.12.77

# Check Docker logs for inference-runtime container
docker logs -f inference-runtime | grep -i "quant"

# Run quick client benchmark (python snippet):
python tools/bench.py --host https://keel-poc.internal --model redwood/llama-3-8b-q4 --batch 4 --samples ./atlaspay_samples.json --stream false > /tmp/keel-bench-$(date +%s).log

=== Config snippets / reminders ===
- model mapping (keel config):
MODEL_MAP:
  atlaspay-prod: redwood/llama-3-8b-q4
  atlaspay-fallback: redwood/llama-3-8b-fp16
  atlaspay-embeddings: redwood/embedding-ae-1

- autoscale rule (draft):
scalePolicy:
  targetRPS: 1200
  maxReplicas: 4
  coolDownSec: 30   # keep to avoid flapping during our perf runs

- caching notes: enable_prefix_kv_cache = true for sessions where prefixLen > 40 tokens; cache size = 6GB initially for PoC.

=== Observed issues (today) ===
1) Strange OOM in inference-runtime when batching 8 sequences of 160 tokens on quantized variant. Stack trace points to aten::cat in kv-cache code path.
   - Temporary workaround: cap batch size to 4 for quantized nodes.
   - Action: file bug with serving-runtime (ENG-4821) + attach logs from /var/log/inference-runtime/oom-20260310.log
2) Customer sees token mismatches vs hosted results (two token differences at end-of-sequence). Suspect tokenizer version mismatch (they use tokenizers v0.12 locally).
   - Ask AtlasPay to confirm tokenizer spec; propose shipping a tokenization-check utility.

=== Questions for customer / handoffs ===
- Can AtlasPay share a sanitized set of 200 conversational turns (with target latency markers)? We need variety (long prompts, short prompts, streaming).
- Confirm preferred rollback policy: immediate rollback vs canary with 10% traffic. For regulatory reasons they prefer explicit approvals.
- Who is responsible for route table changes in their VPC? Provide contact.

=== Meeting notes (2026-03-11 sync) ===
- Attendees: Elliot (me), Maya, AtlasPay: Priya (infra), Omar (platform).
- Priya: wants strict egress controls; asked for list of external endpoints the PoC control plane will hit.
  - TODO: produce minimal endpoint list for Priya by EOD 3/12.
- Omar: asked about audit logs retention for Private. Recommended 90d for PoC, 1y for prod.

=== Follow-ups (by 3/13) ===
- [ ] Send minimal network endpoint list to Priya (include STS, container registry, metrics endpoints). -- assigned to Elliot.
- [ ] Upload tokenization-check tool to support repo + ask AtlasPay to run locally. -- assigned to Maya.
- [ ] Open runtime bug report + add quant OOM logs. ENG-4821 created. -- assigned to Elliot.
- [ ] Schedule canary test after we confirm KV cache health. Prefer 03/15 09:00 UTC.

=== Quick eval plan (for Optimize team) ===
- Baseline: single-turn latency p50/p90/p99 from bench runs.
- Variant tests: q4 quant vs fp16 -> measure accuracy delta on 120-sample eval set (use their metrics: semantic-match, rouge-L).
- Cost estimate: tokens-per-request * 3 variants (cache hit, cache miss, fallback) -> estimate $/1M requests.

=== Random notes / brain dump ===
- Consider shipping a small wrapper that validates tokenizer + normalizes whitespace to avoid mismatch.
- If quantized kernel causes aten::cat OOM, maybe related to split-concat optimization; ask runtime team about using streaming chunk concat instead.
- Keep research notes lightweight here; move finalized runbook to Confluence under atlaspay-poc-runbook when stable.

=== End-of-day (2026-03-12) quick log ===
- Deployed PoC cluster (basic) — confirmed SSH + docker runtime up.
- Ran initial bench: p99 ~ 198ms (batch=1). Good progress but still above 180ms target.
- Increased cache size to 8GB -> single-turn p99 dropped to 176ms on 50-run sample (cache hit heavy).
- Noted minor token mismatch in 3/120 samples; waiting on AtlasPay run of token-check tool.

=== Short-term roadmap (next 7 days) ===
1) Stabilize quantized runtime -> reduce OOMs and increase batch cap to 6.
2) Automate KV-prefetch for known-account prefixes (50% of sessions expected to hit).
3) Do controlled canary (03/15) with 10% traffic: measure latency, errors, accuracy drift.
4) Finalize networking doc + deliver endpoint list to Priya.

=== Personal reminders ===
- Ping SRE about kernel-late-night deploy window (avoid 03/14 PST).
- Add short note in Monday sync about potential need to increase audit retention for production.

---
